source.excerpt: Shared as a pitch-deck analyst that learns your rubric before it scores anything.

body:
## What it does

A ten-question interview turns your actual taste into an explicit, editable profile, and every deck after that is graded against your standard rather than a generic one. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @BrianDEvans shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
